description: This file defines the interface 'DittoMongoClient' that extends 'MongoClient' with additional methods specific to the 'Ditto' project's MongoDB client implementation, including retrieving the default database, getting a collection from the default database, and accessing custom Ditto-specific settings.

classes.name: DittoMongoClient
classes.description: An interface extending MongoClient, providing methods to access default database, specific collections, and custom Ditto settings.

methods.name: getDefaultDatabase
methods.description: Returns the default database associated with this client.

methods.name: getCollection
methods.description: Fetches a collection with the specified name from the default database.

methods.name: getDittoSettings
methods.description: Returns the custom 'Ditto' specific settings used by this client.
